name: ARC-400B Heavy Duty MMA Welder 200A

images.alt: GOWELLDE ARC-400B heavy duty MMA welding machine

summary: 200A workhorse stick welder with the largest capacitor bank in its class.
description: The ARC-400B pairs a 200A output with 4×820µF capacitors and a 12038 cooling fan, built for continuous work on fabrication benches and construction sites. 6.6 kg keeps it portable while the duty cycle supports long weld runs on 2.5–4.0 mm rods.
features: Hot start, anti-stick & arc force adjustment
